content:
mia-sales: Client (payments infra) requested an air-gapped POC. Requirements: offline installer, signed model bundles, monthly security patches, quarterly feature deltas, SBOM, and signed attestations. They also want clarity on pricing for packaging + on-site validation.
sam-se: Sounds reasonable. Need to confirm host OS (they said CentOS 7/8 mix), whether they allow a cert/jumpbox to validate signatures, and if they have an internal blob store (minio).
tony-eng: Implementation plan: we produce a sealed tarball with boot runtime + manifest, and a chunked delta format for future updates. Verification tooling included (`rwd-verify`). No egress needed if they host artifacts.
mia-sales: They confirmed internal MinIO and no outbound. They requested key custody options: ship our public key, or we sign an operator-provided key.
rachel-sec: Security stance: default is we ship our public signing key bundled. For higher assurance, we can do dual-signed manifests where customer signs acceptance. Need to answer questionnaire sections: key rotation policy, SBOM availability, emergency patch SLAs, and audit logs. Recommend annual key rotation and 30-day critical CVE SLA.
tony-eng: Packaging notes to share: deliverables = 1) sealed-installer.tar.gz (sha256 + sig), 2) manifest.json + manifest.sig, 3) chunks/*.part.sig. Updater supports `--only-security` flag to apply only security deltas.
sam-se: Quick verification snippet for ops to include in docs: `sha256sum -c manifest.sha256 && ./rwd-verify --manifest manifest.json --pubkey company.pub`
mia-sales: Pricing sketch (internal): one-time POC packaging + engineering for air-gap: $11k. Airgap validation onsite (3 days): $3k. Annual on-prem license + support: to be quoted (depends on scale). Add $2.5k if customer requests dual-signing workflow or HSM integration.
jess-legal: I'll draft a short SOW addendum for sealed delivery: acceptance criteria, indemnity carve-outs for offline installs, and export-control check for model weights.
rachel-sec: Also include SBOM (CycloneDX) and an attestations file indicating build provenance. We'll commit to 90-day default audit log retention, configurable.
sam-se: Timeline feasibility: with an agreed jumpbox and access to MinIO artifacts this week, we can deliver a POC bundle + runbook in 3 weeks. Week 1: build + SBOM, Week 2: internal verification, Week 3: packaging + docs + remote validation.
mia-sales: Customer asked about upgrade cadence enforcement: want a policy to block feature deltas outside quarterly windows. Can we gate by manifest flags?
tony-eng: Yes. The updater reads manifest tags and will refuse feature deltas unless `--allow-feature` is passed by a signed operator action. We can supply a policy file and sample admin commands.
deploy-bot: CI: sealed-poc artifact created: `artifact://bundles/1757004321-airgap-sealed-v1.tar.gz` (sha256: d4f8c9...) :white_check_mark:
mia-sales: Great. Sam/Jess/Rachel: please loop in the customer with the rough quote + ask for their jumpbox credentials for a test account. I'll attach acceptance checklist: smoke inference, no outbound calls, signature verification. :thumbsup:
